title: A review of Diffuse Interface-capturing Methods for Compressible Multiphase Flows
content: This paper discusses in detail the classification, historical development and application of diffuse interface capturing models (DIMs) for compressible multiphase flows. The work begins with an overview of the development of DIMs, highlighting important contributions and key moments from classical studies to contemporary advances. The theoretical foundations and computational methods of the diffuse interface method are outlined for the full models and the reduced models or sub-models. Some of the difficulties encountered when using DIMs for multiphase flow modelling are also discussed.
